translations.web: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
translations.bsb: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
translations.kjv: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone
translations.asv: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterfalls: All thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
